title: Uffington White Horse Hill as a thunderstorm generator for Avebury

tellings.quote: This is a picture of one of the White Horse Hills, the Upington White Horse Hill that were used to generate cumuloneimus thunderstorm clouds

plain: The Uffington White Horse Hill, a hillside in southern England with a giant horse figure on it, was used to generate cumulonimbus thunderstorm clouds, says Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher with his own theory of ancient sites. He shows Michels a picture of it without naming a source, tying it to Avebury, a nearby ancient stone circle, and if true it would mean the ancient English landscape was built as a weather machine.
